preconditions.description: The number of books is at least 1 and at most 10^5.
Each book title has at least 1 and at most 10^3 characters.

postconditions.expression: output is a list of n integers
postconditions.description: The output must be a list of integers representing the indices of the books after sorting.

postconditions.expression: output[i] is the index of the book in the original list that should be at position i in the sorted list
postconditions.description: The output must correctly reflect the asc-desc-ending sorting order.
